name: Vireio Perception
description: D3D9 / D3D11 stereo + headtracking engine, bundled with Stereopticon. Node-graph plugin architecture; injects via Aquilinus.dll. Long-running fix platform (2012–present); v4.1 modernization (2026) retargets to VS 2026, removes legacy DirectX SDK, adds FreeTrack and OpenXR plugins.
license: LGPL-3.0 (redistributed under GPL-3.0 as part of Stereopticon)

v4.1.0.notes: v4.1 modernization bundled with Stereopticon. Plugin DLLs live in engine/vireio/Release/Perception/bin/x64/plugin/. Per-game profile JSONs select which plugins are wired into the runtime node graph.
